title: FIRST TIME AT THE DRIFTING TRACK SINCE MY ACCIDENT!
description:
MERCH LINK- https://www.scottycranmerbmx.com
Today we went to go hang out at English town with Chris Napp and I went into a drift car for the first time since my accident and it felt awesome. My body handled the turns fine and I had so much fun while Chris was ripping up the track. The rest of the boys drove and rode along and had an awesome time.
author: Scotty Cranmer
